transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. Welcome in. What brings you here today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm Tom. Well, I'm here because I'm having some trouble with my eating. It's gotten pretty bad. 

The main thing that brings me in, and honestly what scares me most, is that once I start eating, it feels like my hands just keep reaching for more food. I'll be sitting there, actually telling myself, "Tom, stop this right now," but I just can't seem to stop.

After one of these episodes where you feel you can't stop eating, do you ever try to get rid of the food or 'make up for it' afterward, like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?

Yes, I do. Um, after I eat too much like that, there are times I go straight to the bathroom and make myself bring it all back up. It's just... I can't stand the thought of it all sitting in there. I've also taken laxatives a few times, just because I get so scared the food is going to stay in me and turn into fat.
On average, how many times per week do these episodes of binge eating followed by vomiting or laxative use happen, and how long has this pattern been going on?

Well, I actually keep track of it in my food logs. And looking back... for many months now, nearly every single week has had at least one afternoon where I just ate completely out of control. And then, you know, I try to make up for it right after—either by making myself vomit, taking laxatives, skipping meals the next day, or just pushing myself really hard with walking and doing chores around the house. It's been happening a lot.

Thinking specifically about the binge-and-purge episodes—not just feeling out of control with food—how many times per week would you say this exact cycle (binging followed by vomiting, laxatives, or similar) has been happening?

Well, like I was just saying, I actually write this all down. According to my logs, for many months now, it's been happening nearly every single week. At least one afternoon a week, I'll have that out-of-control eating, and then I do something right after to fix it—whether that's making myself throw up, taking those laxatives, not eating the next day, or just exhausting myself with walking and doing chores. So, yeah, it's at least once a week, pretty consistently.
